summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing open-market treasury-share purchases on Euronext Milan from 22 to 25 September 2026. Eni bought 3,144,244 shares, or 0.10% of share capital, at a weighted average price of EUR 23.8531 for total consideration of EUR 74,999,852.01 under the second tranche of the buyback approved on 6 May 2026 as additional shareholder remuneration. Since the 8 May 2026 start, Eni has repurchased 73,139,727 shares, 2.42%, for EUR 1,654,915,681.54, and holds 159,967,834 treasury shares, 5.28% of capital. No advisor, premium, or closing date stated. Watch execution pace, remaining authorization, and treasury-share overhang.
